verdict.rationale: The evidence documents an MCP server, a CLI, and an access-gated Platform API with per-operation OpenAPI fragments. None of it shows an official SDK or client library in any language. The API, CLI and MCP surfaces are adjacent building blocks rather than SDKs, and the OpenAPI probe found no downloadable spec from which an SDK might be generated.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
